name: Tucson
registryAssessment: Pima County GIS is the evidenced local cadastral/parcel-map custodian for Tucson and publishes a public parcel map and ArcGIS parcel service. The service is county/regional in scope; citywide Tucson completeness and exact WUP-point inclusion were not verified in this attempt.

queries.query: site:pima.gov GIS parcel map ArcGIS REST Pima County parcel Tucson
queries.result: Found Pima County GIS/PimaMaps public parcel map documentation, the county parcel-search page, and the official GISOpenData LandRecords ArcGIS MapServer with a regional polygon parcel layer.

queries.query: Tucson official parcel GIS map Pima County assessor parcel data
queries.result: Found the City of Tucson parcel-search route and Pima County's public PimaMaps/parcel service references. The official service metadata identifies polygon geometry, native CRS WKID 2868, and the safe parcel field PARCEL.

officialSources.role: Pima County GISOpenData regional parcel polygon layer
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 metadata was readable through the public service. It declares esriGeometryPolygon, native WKID 2868, supported JSON/geoJSON query formats, anonymous querying, maxRecordCount 2000, and PARCEL as the Parcel Tax Code field.
Public map configuration points to the county LandRecords/ParcelsGroup MapServer and lists Parcels, Parcel IDs, Parcel Lot Numbers, and related parcel layers.

County page says parcel information is derived from Pima County Assessor records and other sources and provides parcel-code/address search. It is a search UI, not evidence of a citywide downloadable geometry export.
City route confirms parcel search is backed by Pima County data and links to parcel map functionality; it was not used to request unsafe owner/address fields.

geometryDecision.reason: The official layer schema and CRS were verified, but the bounded anonymous point query did not yield a usable response in this environment: the direct gisdata request returned HTTP 403 and the public pimamaps host presented a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge. No exact-point hit, miss, or parcel polygon was inferred or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Pima County regional parcel layer and public parcel-map services, including Tucson-area parcels.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official public service metadata and local parcel-map configuration; no bounded parcel feature response was retrieved in this attempt.
